notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
First update since the release: two new features and one bug fix.

[h2]Features[/h2]

- [b]Steam achievement[/b]: 14 Steam achievements are now available for Monument Village

- [b]New difficulty "peaceful"[/b]: In this mode, Tessa will not send you any request and you cannot lose. You can build your village and monument at your own pace!

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

- Fixes a deadlock when the available workforce is negative (which can happen after some innovations)


Happy building !
The creator of Monument Village

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
Monument village has an official release date!

[h3]Wednesday, February 14th[/h3]

After a year, the game is almost ready! I'm eager to click the button and hope you'll enjoy the game!

In the meantime, the demo is still available (and will always be). Monument village will also be featured in the next edition of steam NeoFest festival!

Happy building,
The creator of Monument village
